svg.title: F16-4 Rack power chain of one MSC-1 rack: two blocks, two UPS, two busways, two rack PDUs
svg.text: F16-4 Rack power chain of one MSC-1 rack: two blocks, two UPS, two busways, two rack PDUs
2.5 MVA block transformer, 20/0.415 kV, 3,478 A · UPS 2,500 kW at 62.5 % normal, 71.4 % with one block lost · busway 2,500 A, 12 racks · tap-off 250 A · rack 120 kW, 170.4 A at 415 V, pf 0.98
• Normal: 12 racks x 85.2 A = 1,022 A per busway; one block lost: 12 x 170.4 A = 2,045 A on the surviving busway, inside the 2,500 A rating, so the thermal scan runs in that case.
